temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam shows a bright, clear two-lane highway ahead with faded lane markings and a few distant vehicles in light traffic, sharp consistent shadows falling across the asphalt. Around 0:01 a large bird dropping suddenly splatters onto the lens, spreading an irregular milky white-gray smear across the upper-center of the frame, blurring and blotting out much of the road ahead. From 0:02 the vehicle registers the degraded view and slows markedly, the forward motion visibly reducing. Through 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle continues rolling at the reduced speed while the smear stays adhered to the lens, keeping the road ahead partly obscured, the remaining visible portions revealing the sparse traffic continuing along the highway. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady low hum of tires on asphalt and wind noise at highway speed, gradually lowering in pitch as the vehicle decelerates. A faint soft splat sound accompanies the bird dropping impact. A subtle electronic chime and muffled system tone signal the vehicle's recognition of the degraded sensor view. No speech or music.
